title: Go REST API with Gin and Middleware
title_es: REST API en Go con Gin y Middleware
description: Runnable companion for a Go REST API using Gin. Includes logging, auth, request validation, structured error handling, and graceful shutdown.
description_es: Companion ejecutable para una REST API en Go con Gin. Incluye logging, auth, validación de requests, manejo estructurado de errores y graceful shutdown.
